user.title: General Settings
user.description: Configure the sun shade integration update interval.

data_description.update_interval: How often to recalculate sun exposure (30–3600 seconds)

wall.title: Define Wall {wall_number}
wall.description: Enter the geometry for this wall and default window dimensions. Check 'Add another wall' to define more walls.

data.window_count: Number of windows on this wall

data_description.wall_id: Unique identifier for this wall (e.g. wall_1)
data_description.outward_normal_azimuth_deg: Compass bearing of the wall's outward-facing normal (0=N, 90=E, 180=S, 270=W)
data_description.wall_thickness: Thickness of the wall in meters
data_description.wall_axis: Which coordinate axis the wall runs along (X or Y). Both walls meet at the corner origin.
data_description.window_count: How many windows are on this wall
data_description.default_window_width: Default width for windows on this wall
data_description.default_window_height: Default height for windows on this wall
data_description.default_z_bottom: Default bottom elevation of windows on this wall
data_description.default_z_top: Default top elevation of windows on this wall

window.title: Window {window_number} on {wall_id} ({wall_axis}-axis)
window.description: Position is measured along the {wall_axis}-axis from the corner where walls meet. Width, height, and Z values are pre-filled from wall defaults.

data_description.window_id: Unique identifier for this window (e.g. window_1a)
data_description.position_along_wall: Distance from the corner origin to the inner edge of the window, measured along the {wall_axis}-axis
data_description.shade_entity_id: Cover entity that controls the shade for this window

plant.title: Plant Position
plant.description: Define the plant location as perpendicular distances from each wall into the room.

data_description.plant_dist_wall1: Perpendicular distance from {wall_1_id} into the room to the plant center
data_description.plant_dist_wall2: Perpendicular distance from {wall_2_id} into the room to the plant center
